rationale.conceptual: The G3 method is an established composite protocol combining multiple MP2/QCISD(T) single-point energies and corrections; it is not a novel algorithm but requires careful handling of basis sets, energy combinations, and transition state verification. RRKM theory is standard but non-trivial, demanding correct implementation of microcanonical rate constants and master equation solutions. The underlying science is well-documented, but the implementation is multi-part and needs domain knowledge.
rationale.execution: The reproduction involves constructing guess structures, running MP2 geometry optimizations and frequency calculations, verifying transition states, performing G3 composite single-point calculations, deriving relative enthalpies, then feeding vibrational frequencies and barrier heights into an RRKM/master equation code. This is a 4-5 stage pipeline with dependencies spanning quantum chemistry software and a kinetics solver, requiring careful data handoffs.
